name: Network AI
description: Multi-agent swarm orchestrator for AI workflows. Exposes blackboard read/write, agent dispatch, permission gating (AuthGuardian), token budget enforcement (FederatedBudget), and audit log tools over MCP. Supports 14 AI framework adapters including LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Codex, and A2A — mix any frameworks in one swarm with race-condition-safe shared state.(Traffic light for agents)
